IT & Systems

IT and Systems team is responsible for design, development, testing, integrating & implementation of platforms (software solutions) and business automation for S&D, Customer On-boarding, Bill & Pay, Network Management and Enterprise functions (HR, Finance & SCM) for Jio. Also responsible to provide L3 support for stable operations of the platform at desired scale supporting millions of customer acquisitions per day.
